解答 $\Gamma$ 即 $\begin{cases}x^2+y^2=1\\z=\sqrt{3}\end{cases}$，或 $\Gamma:\begin{cases}x=\cos t\\y=\sin t,t\in[0,2\pi]\\z=\sqrt{3}\end{cases}$，

$$
\oint_\Gamma(x^2+x)ds=\int_0^{2\pi}(\cos^2t+\cos t)\sqrt{(\cos t)'^2+(\sin t)'^2+(\sqrt{3})'^2}\,dt
$$

$$
=\int_0^{2\pi}(\cos^2t+\cos t)dt=\pi.
$$
